title: Relay frame size check
responsibility: Determines whether a text or binary frame exceeds the byte limit.

inputs.name: frameTooLarge.message
inputs.description: The frame to measure: a text string, measured as its UTF-8 byte count, or a binary ArrayBuffer, measured by its byteLength. Only the byte size is used, and any value that is not a string is read through byteLength with no type check.

inputs.name: frameTooLarge.limit
inputs.description: Defaults to remoteLimits.frameBytes: the frameBytes entry of remoteLimits, imported from the remote package. A frame counts as too large only when its byte size is strictly greater than this value, and the number is used as given with no range check.

outputs.name: frameTooLarge
outputs.description: True only when the frame's byte size is strictly greater than the limit, so a frame exactly at the limit returns false. For text, a UTF-16 code-unit length above the limit returns true, and that length times three at or below the limit returns false, both without encoding; other text is UTF-8 encoded to count its bytes.
